"""Versioned, explicitly reviewed territorial registry; keep MAP2K frozen."""
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def active_registry_path():
    newer=ROOT/'docs/reports/map/MAP2L/IMPERIAL_DE_JURE_REGISTRY.json'
    return newer if newer.exists() else ROOT/'docs/reports/map/MAP2K/IMPERIAL_DE_JURE_REGISTRY.json'

def additional_members():
    if active_registry_path().parent.name=='MAP2L':return ['LGE','STM','SAR']+[t for m in approved_territorial_migrations() for t in m['new_members']]
    return []

def additional_free_cities():
    """Only explicitly declared city estates, not every republican member."""
    result=[]
    for migration in approved_territorial_migrations():
        cities=migration.get('free_cities',[])
        assert set(cities)<=set(migration['new_members'])
        for tag in cities:
            if tag not in result:result.append(tag)
    return result

def member_region_overrides():
    # Membership is country-wide, whereas territorial rights are explicit.
    # Do not register Sardinia, Savoy or every other possession of this member.
    return {'SAR': {'STATE_PIEDMONT'}}

def territorial_holder_overrides():
    """A registered ducal possession is not country-wide bloc membership."""
    result={}
    # Only this explicitly approved manifest may introduce the Swedish title.
    # Do not repeatedly parse every large earlier geometry migration per RGB.
    path=ROOT/'docs/reports/map/MAP2L/PRUSSIAN_BORDERS/REGISTRY_MIGRATION.json'
    for m in ([json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))] if path.exists() else []):
        for tag,regions in m.get('external_territorial_holders',{}).items():
            assert tag=='SWE' and regions==['STATE_POMERANIA']
            result[tag]=set(regions)
    # Separate, additive MAP2N approval: four frozen Swedish Mecklenburg
    # provinces. This never confers country-wide imperial membership.
    completion=ROOT/'docs/reports/map/MAP2N/COMPLETION/REGISTRY_MIGRATION.json'
    if completion.exists():
        m=json.loads(completion.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert m.get('external_territorial_holders')=={'SWE':['STATE_MECKLENBURG']}
        assert m.get('external_holder_RGBs')==['xEDB102','xEDB103','xEDB104','xEDB105']
        assert not m['new_members']
        assert {(r['rgb'],r['state'],r['owner']) for r in m['new_provinces']}=={(rgb,'STATE_MECKLENBURG','SWE') for rgb in m['external_holder_RGBs']}
        result.setdefault('SWE',set()).add('STATE_MECKLENBURG')
    return result

def rightful_holder_condition(row):
    """Use the reviewed province-specific Swedish title, never a member flag."""
    tag=row['beneficiary']
    if row['state'] in territorial_holder_overrides().get(tag,set()):
        return 'exists = c:'+tag
    return 'c:'+tag+' ?= { aor1776_hre_member = yes }'

def approved_territorial_extensions():
    manifest=ROOT/'docs/reports/map/MAP2L/PIEDMONT/EXTENSION.json'
    return json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['provinces'] if manifest.exists() else []

def approved_territorial_migrations():
    return [json.loads((p/'REGISTRY_MIGRATION.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in approved_lot_dirs()]

def provincial_membership_overrides():
    """Exact reviewed RGB exceptions, never a whole State Region inclusion."""
    return {(r['rgb'],r['state'],r['owner']) for m in approved_territorial_migrations() for r in m.get('province_membership_overrides',[])}

def reviewed_core_exception_owner(point,previous_owner,later_dirs):
    """Only the human-approved Kempten municipal cell, never a broad waiver."""
    result=previous_owner
    for directory in later_dirs:
        migration=json.loads((directory/'REGISTRY_MIGRATION.json').read_text())
        for exc in migration.get('core_exceptions',[]):
            assert directory.name=='SWABIA_COMPLETION'
            assert (exc['preceding_lot'],exc['rgb'],exc['previous_owner'],exc['new_owner'],exc['cells'])==('SWABIA','xEDAD0D','SKE','SKI',[[4324,928]])
            if list(point) not in exc['cells']:continue
            assert result==exc['previous_owner'],'Broken protected-core exception chain'
            geo=json.loads((directory/'GEOMETRY.json').read_text())
            changed=[r for r in geo['assignments'] if list(point) in r['cells']]
            assert len(changed)==1 and changed[0]['owner']==exc['new_owner'] and changed[0]['parent_rgb']==exc['rgb'] and changed[0]['previous_owner']==result and changed[0]['pixels']==1
            result=exc['new_owner']
    return result

def protected_core_preserved(row,bitmap,owners,later_dirs):
    """Exact core identity/count, minus only independently declared exceptions."""
    color=int(row['rgb'][1:],16);retained=0
    for point in row['cells']:
        x,y=point;expected=reviewed_core_exception_owner(point,row['owner'],later_dirs)
        actual_rgb='x'+format(int(bitmap[y,x]),'06X')
        if owners.get(actual_rgb)!=expected:return False
        if expected==row['owner']:
            retained+=1
            if bitmap[y,x]!=color:return False
    return owners.get(row['rgb'])==row['owner'] and int((bitmap==color).sum())==retained

def expected_locator_rgb(original,point,later_dirs):
    """Replay exact approved hub RGB rebindings, never physical movement."""
    value=original
    for directory in later_dirs:
        migration=json.loads((directory/'REGISTRY_MIGRATION.json').read_text())
        for binding in migration.get('region_reference_changes',[]):
            if binding.get('pixel')==list(point):
                assert int(binding.get('bitmap_before',binding['before'])[1:],16)==value
                value=int(binding['after'][1:],16)
    return value

def effective_assignments(geometries):
    """Explicit ordered geometry layers; later splits replace their parent only."""
    rows=[]
    for g in geometries:
        parents=set(g.get('parents',[]))
        rows=[r for r in rows if r['rgb'] not in parents]+g['assignments']
    return rows


def expected_country_definitions(before,migrations):
    """Only exact declared additions; never waive preservation of an old tag."""
    expected=dict(before)
    for migration in migrations:
        change=migration.get('anhalt_name_correction')
        if change:
            assert migration['new_members']==['ABG','AKT','AZR'] and change['tag']=='ANH'
            assert expected['ANH']==change['before_signature']
            node=json.loads(expected['ANH']);fields=[v for v in node[2] if v[0]=='is_named_from_capital']
            assert len(fields)==1 and fields[0][2]=='yes'
            fields[0][2]='no'
            signature=json.dumps(node,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
            assert signature==change['after_signature'],'Only explicit Anhalt naming may change'
            expected['ANH']=signature
        # A reviewed Swabian correction, not a permission to rewrite an old
        # country. Reconstruct the resulting signature by changing tier only.
        for change in migration.get('country_tier_corrections',[]):
            tag=change['tag']
            if tag=='WUR':
                assert change['before']=='kingdom' and change['after']=='principality'
            elif tag=='HES':
                assert migration.get('new_members')==['NOU','NWB'] and migration.get('replaced_regions')==['STATE_HESSE']
                assert change['before']=='grand_principality' and change['after']=='principality'
            else:
                assert migration.get('replaced_regions')==['STATE_SAXONY']
                assert migration.get('new_members')==['GOT','HIL','SSO','RGZ','RGE','RSL']
                assert (tag,change['before'],change['after']) in {('SAX','kingdom','principality'),('WEI','grand_principality','principality')}
            assert expected[tag]==change['before_signature']
            node=json.loads(expected[tag]);tiers=[v for v in node[2] if v[0]=='tier']
            assert len(tiers)==1 and tiers[0][2]==change['before']
            tiers[0][2]=change['after']
            signature=json.dumps(node,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
            assert signature==change['after_signature'],'Only the explicitly approved country tier may change'
            expected[tag]=signature
        for change in migration.get('country_capital_corrections',[]):
            assert migration.get('new_members')==['RLO','REB']
            assert migration.get('replaced_regions')==['STATE_SAXONY','STATE_ANHALT']
            assert (change['tag'],change['before'],change['after'])==('SSO','STATE_SAXONY','STATE_ANHALT')
            assert expected['SSO']==change['before_signature']
            node=json.loads(expected['SSO']);capitals=[v for v in node[2] if v[0]=='capital']
            assert len(capitals)==1 and capitals[0][2]=='STATE_SAXONY'
            capitals[0][2]='STATE_ANHALT'
            signature=json.dumps(node,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
            assert signature==change['after_signature'],'Only the Sondershausen capital region may change'
            expected['SSO']=signature
        additions=migration.get('country_additions',{})
        assert set(additions)<=set(migration['new_members'])
        for tag,signature in additions.items():
            assert tag not in expected,'Existing country cannot be overwritten '+tag
            expected[tag]=signature
    return expected


def rebind_state_definitions(raw,migrations):
    """Replay only documented hub-RGB references and prime-land expansion."""
    import validate_diplomacy_ottoman_1776 as parser
    from map_1776_audit import values
    from map2a_patch import edits
    for migration in migrations:
        for change in migration.get('region_reference_changes',[]):
            assert change['field'] in {'city','port','farm','mine','wood','prime_land'}
            assert change['state'] in migration['replaced_regions']
            nodes={n.key:n for n in parser.parse(raw)}
            # A cumulative validator may be checking a different region file
            # (e.g. Italy); no Westphalian node can be rebound in that file.
            if change['state'] not in nodes:continue
            region=nodes[change['state']]
            field=region.children(change['field'])[0]
            if change['field']=='prime_land':
                assert values(region,'prime_land')==change['before']
                replacement='prime_land = { '+' '.join('"'+rgb+'"' for rgb in change['after'])+' }'
            else:
                assert parser.scalar(field.value)==change['before']
                replacement=change['field']+' = "'+change['after']+'"'
            raw=edits(raw,[(field.start,field.end,replacement)])
    return raw

def ancestor_rgb(rgb,existing_colors):
    """Resolve only declared child chains to an immutable bitmap's RGB set."""
    parents={r['rgb']:r['parent_rgb'] for fp in approved_lot_dirs() for r in json.loads((fp/'GEOMETRY.json').read_text())['new_provinces']}
    seen=set()
    while int(rgb[1:],16) not in existing_colors:
        assert rgb not in seen and rgb in parents,'Undeclared or cyclic parent chain '+rgb
        seen.add(rgb);rgb=parents[rgb]
    return int(rgb[1:],16)

def apply_territorial_migrations(rows):
    current=list(rows)
    for m in approved_territorial_migrations():
        regions=set(m['replaced_regions'])
        previous=[r for r in current if r['state'] in regions]
        assert sorted(previous,key=lambda r:r['rgb'])==sorted(m['previous'],key=lambda r:r['rgb']),'Unreviewed registry migration input'
        current=[r for r in current if r['state'] not in regions]+m['updated']
    return sorted(current,key=lambda r:(r['rgb'],r['state'],r['beneficiary']))


def ownership_rows(migration,phase):
    """A nonmember border split must not turn its ownership into imperial rights."""
    return migration.get('ownership_'+phase,migration[phase])


def migrate_extent(mask,migrations):
    """Only exact, explicitly recorded raster cells may extend/remove rights."""
    result=mask.copy()
    for migration in migrations:
        for field,value in [('extent_removed_cells',False),('extent_added_cells',True)]:
            cells=migration.get(field,[])
            assert len({tuple(c) for c in cells})==len(cells),'Duplicate extent cells'
            for x,y in cells:
                assert 0<=y<result.shape[0] and 0<=x<result.shape[1]
                assert bool(result[y,x])!=value,'Extent migration is not a delta'
                result[y,x]=value
    return result

 war_goal_aor1776_hre_liberate_estate_name:0 "Liberate [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName]"
 war_goal_aor1776_hre_liberate_estate_desc:0 "Free [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName] from its overlord. Occupation requirements concern the targeted estate, not the external overlord’s capital."

 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_desc:0 "An imperial estate must immediately restore the listed registered provinces. It cannot refuse unless the Emperor owes it an obligation; that case uses the approval-based request instead."
 aor1776_hre_reply_infamy:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_new_infamy_holder').GetName] received 5 infamy for this first refusal. The imperial casus belli lasts ten years; existing truces remain binding."

 aor1776_hre.35.t:0 "An imperial estate regains its liberty"
 aor1776_hre.1.f:0 "#italic “He left nine places for the seals, and a tenth for the silence of the dead Emperor. No envoy wished to speak first.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.20.f:0 "#italic “The border had moved on the map, but not in the old register. The envoy set both upon the table and waited.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.21.f:0 "#italic “Beneath the foreign seal lay three smaller impressions. The clerk traced each one with a finger, as if freeing a name from its wax.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.30.f:0 "#italic “At dawn, the city gates opened without a shot. The messenger read the decree twice; the second time, the crowd answered.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.30.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has released the imperial estates listed in our council’s settlement. Their liberty and registered territorial rights have been restored."
 aor1776_hre.30.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has released the imperial estates listed in our council’s settlement. Their liberty and registered territorial rights have been restored.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.31.f:0 "#italic “The letter returned with its seal unbroken. In the council chamber, the rustle of paper sounded louder than an insult.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.32.f:0 "#italic “The surveyor rubbed out the latest line. Beneath it, faint but stubborn, the older boundary remained.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.32.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has restored the registered provinces to their lawful imperial holders. The settlement’s exact territories appear below."
 aor1776_hre.32.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has restored the registered provinces to their lawful imperial holders. The settlement’s exact territories appear below.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.33.f:0 "#italic “The envoy folded the rejected summons. Outside, a groom held his horse; inside, no one offered him a chair.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.33.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has rejected the territorial summons. An external holder’s refusal authorises restitution proceedings; a protected imperial member retains the right to refuse."
 aor1776_hre.34.f:0 "#italic “When the final seal cooled, the clerk carried the register back to its shelf. For once, the ink and the border agreed.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.34.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has submitted to the imperial settlement. The subjects and registered territories concerned are recorded below."
 aor1776_hre.34.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has submitted to the imperial settlement. The subjects and registered territories concerned are recorded below.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.35.f:0 "#italic “The old banner rose slowly over the square. No one cheered until its shadow reached the courthouse steps.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.35.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] is released from foreign overlordship. The settlement restores its imperial standing and returns only those registered provinces it held contrary to other estates’ rights."
 aor1776_hre.35.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] is released from foreign overlordship. The settlement restores its imperial standing and returns only those registered provinces it held contrary to other estates’ rights.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.41.f:0 "#italic “They removed the empty chair from the wall and brought it back to the council table. Its owner had never ceased to claim his place.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.60.f:0 "#italic “Each envoy brought a different map. By nightfall, they had begun to argue over a single page.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.61.f:0 "#italic “The prince kept his keys, his court and his guards. Only the oath at the bottom of the parchment had changed.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.62.f:0 "#italic “Orders now arrived beneath the same eagle. The old seals remained, but the clerk no longer asked which road the letter should take.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.63.f:0 "#italic “The shelves still bore the names of the former courts. One register lay open upon the desk; for the first time, it named them all.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."

 aor1776_hre.35.t:0 "Un État impérial retrouve sa liberté"
 aor1776_hre.1.f:0 "#italic « Il réserva neuf places aux sceaux, et une dixième au silence de l’empereur mort. Aucun envoyé ne voulait parler le premier. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.20.f:0 "#italic « La frontière avait bougé sur la carte, mais non dans le vieux registre. L’envoyé posa les deux sur la table et attendit. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.21.f:0 "#italic « Sous le sceau étranger reposaient trois empreintes plus petites. Le clerc les suivit du doigt, comme pour libérer un nom de sa cire. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.30.f:0 "#italic « À l’aube, les portes de la ville s’ouvrirent sans un coup de feu. Le messager lut deux fois le décret ; à la seconde, la foule répondit. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.30.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a libéré les États impériaux désignés par notre conseil. Leur liberté et leurs droits territoriaux enregistrés ont été rétablis."
 aor1776_hre.30.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a libéré les États impériaux désignés par notre conseil. Leur liberté et leurs droits territoriaux enregistrés ont été rétablis.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.31.f:0 "#italic « La lettre revint, son sceau intact. Dans la salle du conseil, le froissement du papier retentit plus fort qu’une insulte. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.32.f:0 "#italic « L’arpenteur effaça le trait le plus récent. Dessous, pâle mais obstinée, demeurait l’ancienne frontière. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.32.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a restitué les provinces enregistrées à leurs titulaires impériaux légitimes. Les territoires précis du règlement sont indiqués ci-dessous."
 aor1776_hre.32.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a restitué les provinces enregistrées à leurs titulaires impériaux légitimes. Les territoires précis du règlement sont indiqués ci-dessous.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.33.f:0 "#italic « L’envoyé replia la sommation rejetée. Dehors, un palefrenier retenait son cheval ; dedans, personne ne lui offrit de chaise. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.33.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a rejeté la sommation territoriale. Le refus d’un détenteur extérieur ouvre la voie à une rétrocession ; un membre impérial protégé conserve son droit de refus."
 aor1776_hre.34.f:0 "#italic « Lorsque le dernier sceau eut refroidi, le clerc remit le registre sur son étagère. Pour une fois, l’encre et la frontière s’accordaient. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.34.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] s’est soumis au règlement impérial. Les sujets et territoires enregistrés concernés sont consignés ci-dessous."
 aor1776_hre.34.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] s’est soumis au règlement impérial. Les sujets et territoires enregistrés concernés sont consignés ci-dessous.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.35.f:0 "#italic « La vieille bannière s’éleva lentement au-dessus de la place. Nul n’acclama avant que son ombre atteignît les marches du tribunal. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.35.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] est libéré de la suzeraineté étrangère. Le règlement rétablit sa place dans l’Empire et ne restitue que les provinces enregistrées détenues en violation des droits d’autres États."
 aor1776_hre.35.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] est libéré de la suzeraineté étrangère. Le règlement rétablit sa place dans l’Empire et ne restitue que les provinces enregistrées détenues en violation des droits d’autres États.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.41.f:0 "#italic « On retira la chaise vide du mur pour la remettre à la table du conseil. Son propriétaire n’avait jamais cessé de réclamer sa place. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.60.f:0 "#italic « Chaque envoyé avait apporté une carte différente. À la nuit tombée, ils avaient commencé à débattre d’une seule page. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.61.f:0 "#italic « Le prince conserva ses clefs, sa cour et ses gardes. Seul le serment au bas du parchemin avait changé. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.62.f:0 "#italic « Les ordres arrivaient désormais sous le même aigle. Les vieux sceaux demeuraient, mais le clerc ne demandait plus quel chemin devait prendre la lettre. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.63.f:0 "#italic « Les étagères portaient encore les noms des anciennes cours. Un registre ouvert reposait sur le bureau ; pour la première fois, il les nommait toutes. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
